name: uppercut-skills
description: All 20 public Uppercut Labs skills, including the Starter Pack learner companion and computer setup.

start.description: Start or resume Starter Pack with its installed skills
start.content: Use the bundled starter-pack skill to start or resume the learner's actual saved course progress. Never assume missing progress means a fresh learner. Resolve the current canonical requirements and show one next action. For Phase 2 use the already installed computer-setup skill without reinstallation; full curriculum Grill to Build is the default, and curriculum Quick Build is used only when the learner asks. Follow the course-specific current skill instructions rather than standalone engineering workflows. Obtain approval for installations, plans, deployment and account changes; verify real outcomes, save private progress and offer Phase 3 only after Phase 2 closeout. Plugin installation itself is not course completion.
